scope_note.zh: 范围为中国内地火山方舟按量 API：收录核对日官方模型列表文本生成栏的豆包自研 Model ID，含角色、翻译及多模态理解语言模型；已下线版本不列入，也不作为历史档案。排除转售型号、图像/视频/3D 生成、独立语音服务、向量、重排、纯 OCR 和单一意图分类器。Coding/Agent Plan 的入口、短名称和生命周期须另查订阅文档，不与按量 API 混用。往期、EOM 与 EOS 分开判断，价目中出现不等于可用；实际权限以地域、账户及控制台为准。本表是官方资料核对而非 API 实测，不包含固定价格或调用参数上限。
scope_note.en: Scope: mainland-China Ark pay-as-you-go API. Includes Doubao-owned Model IDs from the official catalog's text-generation section on the check date, including character, translation and multimodal-understanding language models. Retired versions are excluded; this list is not a historical archive. Excludes resold models, image/video/3D generation, standalone speech services, embeddings, rerankers, pure OCR and single-purpose intent classifiers. Coding/Agent Plan endpoints, short names and lifecycles require separate subscription documentation and are not interchangeable with pay-as-you-go API IDs. Past-model status, EOM and EOS are distinct; a price listing alone is not availability evidence. Region, account and console permissions still apply. This is an official-document inventory, not an API execution test; it contains no copied prices or request limits.

notes.zh: 统一 Model ID 指向持续更新的模型服务，不是固定快照；当前官方列为推荐型号。支持视觉理解，不支持音频理解；本表不把 Coding Plan 的短名称当作按量 API 别名。
notes.en: A rolling Model ID for an automatically updated service, not a pinned snapshot; currently recommended in the official catalog. Visual understanding is supported, but audio understanding is not. Coding Plan short names are not treated as pay-as-you-go aliases here.

notes.en: A fixed-version Model ID recommended in the official catalog. This status concerns Ark pay-as-you-go API access, not subscription-plan availability.
